# Operational Tool Manifest

This file tracks the capability extensions designed for Operator utility rather than Lyla's self-governance.

## Current Projects
- **Contextual Intelligence Digest**: Transforming raw state/memories into high-signal summaries tailored to operator needs. [In Progress]

## Logic Baseline
The core principle is "Anti-Dashboard." Instead of adding more screens for the human to watch, we build pipelines that push essential information only when it reaches a specific relevance threshold or requested cadence.
